# Harbourside beach clean

The clean is on Saturday 6 November 2027, from 10:00 to 13:00. We meet at the slipway car park, by the lifeboat station.

Each group takes one stretch of the beach:

- Harbour wall to the slipway: Harbour Scouts
- Slipway to the groynes: Marlow Sailing Club
- Groynes to the old pier: Mill Row Residents
- Dune path: not yet given to a group

The council lends litter pickers, sacks and hi-vis vests. Group leaders collect them from the lifeboat station at 09:30. Volunteers bring their own gloves and wear sturdy shoes.
